key: SHELLY: They seem really close...
en: SHELLY: They seem really close...
ja: シェリー: あの人たち、本当に仲がいいんだね……

key: Anna and Noel, too.
en: Anna and Noel, too.
ja: アンナとノエルも。

key: Why can't my brother and I be close like that?
en: Why can't my brother and I be close like that?
ja: どうして私とお兄ちゃんは、あんな風に仲良くなれないんだろう?

key: SHELLY: I hope Anna's okay...
en: SHELLY: I hope Anna's okay...
ja: シェリー: アンナが大丈夫だといいけど……

key: You know what she said before? About me really having lots of friends?
en: You know what she said before? About me really having lots of friends?
ja: さっき言ってくれたこと、覚えてる? 私にたくさん友達がいるって話。

key: I know it's not true, but...
en: I know it's not true, but...
ja: 本当じゃないってわかってるけど……

key: It made me really happy anyway.
en: It made me really happy anyway.
ja: それでも、すごくうれしかった。

key: LAURA: Noel? Anna?
en: LAURA: Noel? Anna?
ja: ローラ: ノエル? アンナ?

key: ???: Noel? Anna?
en: ???: Noel? Anna?
ja: ???: ノエル? アンナ?

key: What are you two doing here?
en: What are you two doing here?
ja: あなたたち、こんなところで何を?

key: LAURA: Charlotte!
en: LAURA: Charlotte!
ja: ローラ: シャルロット!

key: ???: Charlotte!
en: ???: Charlotte!
ja: ???: シャルロット!

key: But shouldn't you all still be at the Orphanage........?
en: But shouldn't you all still be at the Orphanage........?
ja: でも、みんなまだ孤児院にいるはずじゃ……?

key: CHARLOTTE: We decided we'd had enough of the geezer, so we hooked him up to his own shock machine and gave him the once-through.
en: CHARLOTTE: We decided we'd had enough of the geezer, so we hooked him up to his own shock machine and gave him the once-through.
ja: シャルロット: あのジジイにはもう我慢の限界だったから、自分の電気ショック機械につないで、一発かましてやったの。

key: LAURA: Wh-what, really........?
en: LAURA: Wh-what, really........?
ja: ローラ: ほ、本当に……?

key: ???: Wh-what, really........?
en: ???: Wh-what, really........?

key: CHARLOTTE: I wish.
en: CHARLOTTE: I wish.
ja: シャルロット: そうだったらよかったんだけどね。

key: But we flew the coop, and need to lay low here for a while.
en: But we flew the coop, and need to lay low here for a while.
ja: でも、実際は逃げ出しただけで、しばらくここに身を潜めなきゃいけないの。

key: CHARLOTTE: \PN, Shelly, this is Laura.
en: CHARLOTTE: \PN, Shelly, this is Laura.
ja: シャルロット: \PN、シェリー、こっちはローラ。

key: My sister.
en: My sister.
ja: あたしの妹。

key: LAURA: \PN and I have met already, actually.
en: LAURA: \PN and I have met already, actually.
ja: ローラ: \PNとは、実はもう会っているんです。

key: Thanks again for your help with that little project earlier~
en: Thanks again for your help with that little project earlier~
ja: さっきのちょっとしたプロジェクト、手伝ってくれてありがとうございました~

key: Saphira loved it,
en: Saphira loved it,
ja: サファイラ、とても気に入っていましたよ、

key: Even if she forgot the words to say so.
en: Even if she forgot the words to say so.
ja: それを言葉にするのを忘れちゃったみたいですけど。

key: Speaking of, I ended up passing that little project of ours off to Lapis' Sweet Scent Flower Shop.
en: Speaking of, I ended up passing that little project of ours off to Lapis' Sweet Scent Flower Shop.
ja: そういえば、あのプロジェクト、結局ラピスの「甘い香りの花屋」に引き継いだんです。

key: It sounded like they could still use some help finishing it, so maybe check by if you happen to be in the area.
en: It sounded like they could still use some help finishing it, so maybe check by if you happen to be in the area.
ja: 仕上げにまだ手が必要そうだったので、もし近くに行くことがあれば、のぞいてみてください。

key: LAURA: Well, it's a pleasure to meet you both, if unexpected.
en: LAURA: Well, it's a pleasure to meet you both, if unexpected.
ja: ローラ: それでは、思いがけずですけど、お二人にお会いできて光栄です。

key: SHELLY: Um, it's-- um, nice to meet you too!
en: SHELLY: Um, it's-- um, nice to meet you too!
ja: シェリー: あ、その……よ、よろしくお願いします!

key: CHARLOTTE: They helped us escape from the Doctor, and we thought it might be too dangerous for them to go back to the city.
en: CHARLOTTE: They helped us escape from the Doctor, and we thought it might be too dangerous for them to go back to the city.
ja: シャルロット: ドクターから逃げるのを手伝ってくれたんだけど、街に戻るのは危険すぎるかもって思って。

key: So they'll be staying here too for a while.
en: So they'll be staying here too for a while.
ja: だから、しばらくここに一緒にいてもらうことにしたの。

key: NOEL: Is there anywhere Anna can lie down?
en: NOEL: Is there anywhere Anna can lie down?
ja: ノエル: アンナが横になれる場所はある?

key: Nostra isn't feeling well, apparently.
en: Nostra isn't feeling well, apparently.
ja: ノストラの具合が悪いみたいなんだ。

key: LAURA: Oh........ Right, of course.
en: LAURA: Oh........ Right, of course.
ja: ローラ: あら……ええ、もちろんです。

key: Follow me upstairs?
en: Follow me upstairs?
ja: 二階までついてきてもらえますか?

key: CHARLOTTE: Laura was kept with us at the Orphanage too, until very recently.
en: CHARLOTTE: Laura was kept with us at the Orphanage too, until very recently.
ja: シャルロット: ローラも、つい最近まで孤児院にいたの。

key: She just turned 18, so as a legal adult, she was finally free to go.
en: She just turned 18, so as a legal adult, she was finally free to go.
ja: 18歳になったばかりで、法律上の成人として、やっと自由になれたんだよね。

key: So she came here.
en: So she came here.
ja: それでここに来たの。

key: It used to be our parents' house, so it's the safest place for us right now.
en: It used to be our parents' house, so it's the safest place for us right now.
ja: ここは元々あたしたちの両親の家だから、今のあたしたちにとって一番安全な場所なの。

key: And by the looks of it, she redecorated.
en: And by the looks of it, she redecorated.
ja: それに見た感じ、模様替えもしたみたい。

key: ...Again.
en: ...Again.
ja: ……また。

key: SHELLY: Charlotte, what ever happened to your parents?
en: SHELLY: Charlotte, what ever happened to your parents?
ja: シェリー: シャルロット、ご両親には何があったの?

key: CHARLOTTE: That's not important.
en: CHARLOTTE: That's not important.
ja: シャルロット: それはどうでもいいの。

key: SHELLY: O-oh, I'm sorry...
en: SHELLY: O-oh, I'm sorry...
ja: シェリー: あ、ご、ごめん……

key: LAURA: Poor thing went right to sleep.
en: LAURA: Poor thing went right to sleep.
ja: ローラ: かわいそうに、すぐに眠ってしまいました。

key: She's running an awful fever........
en: She's running an awful fever........
ja: ひどい熱があって……

key: CHARLOTTE: Do we have any medicine around?
en: CHARLOTTE: Do we have any medicine around?
ja: シャルロット: 薬、何かある?

key: LAURA: No, I'm afraid not.
en: LAURA: No, I'm afraid not.
ja: ローラ: いいえ、残念ながら。

key: Though, I believe the PokéMart in Spinel Town was selling some Herbal Extract?
en: Though, I believe the PokéMart in Spinel Town was selling some Herbal Extract?
ja: でも、スピネルタウンのポケモンショップで、やくそうエキスを売っていたと思います。

key: It's a wonderful all-natural and cruelty-free cure-all made from the flowers Comfey gather.
en: It's a wonderful all-natural and cruelty-free cure-all made from the flowers Comfey gather.
ja: キュワワーが集める花から作られた、天然素材で動物にも優しい、素晴らしい万能薬です。

key: CHARLOTTE: All right.
en: CHARLOTTE: All right.
ja: シャルロット: わかった。

key: \PN, go into town and get that Herbal Extract for Anna.
en: \PN, go into town and get that Herbal Extract for Anna.
ja: \PN、町に行って、アンナのためにやくそうエキスを取ってきて。

key: Spinel Town is completely separate from Reborn City-- just a little camp on the edge.
en: Spinel Town is completely separate from Reborn City-- just a little camp on the edge.
ja: スピネルタウンはリボーンシティとは完全に独立した、端っこにある小さな集落なの。

key: If you go back from the cove and follow the train tracks east, you'll find it.
en: If you go back from the cove and follow the train tracks east, you'll find it.
ja: 入り江から戻って、線路を東に沿っていけば見つかるはず。

key: LAURA: Oh, if you have to go out, you might want to rest up first.
en: LAURA: Oh, if you have to go out, you might want to rest up first.
ja: ローラ: あら、出かける前に、少し休んでいったほうがいいかもしれません。

key: Follow me, \PN.
en: Follow me, \PN.
ja: \PN、こちらへどうぞ。

key: CHARLOTTE: There you are.
en: CHARLOTTE: There you are.
ja: シャルロット: いたいた。

key: What, did you get lost?
en: What, did you get lost?
ja: なに、迷子になった?

key: I told my sister we had another person with us, but then we turned around and you were gone.
en: I told my sister we had another person with us, but then we turned around and you were gone.
ja: 妹にはもう一人一緒だって言ったのに、振り返ったらいなくなってたから。

key: Well, whatever.
en: Well, whatever.
ja: まあ、いいけど。

key: \PN, this is my sister, Laura.
en: \PN, this is my sister, Laura.
ja: \PN、こっちが妹のローラ。

key: LAURA: It's a pleasure to meet you.
en: LAURA: It's a pleasure to meet you.
ja: ローラ: お会いできて光栄です。

key: Charlotte has already explained the current situation to me.
en: Charlotte has already explained the current situation to me.
ja: シャルロットから、今の状況はもう聞いています。

key: You are, of course, welcome to stay in our home for as long as you like to feel safe.
en: You are, of course, welcome to stay in our home for as long as you like to feel safe.
ja: もちろん、安心できるまで、いつまでもこの家に滞在してくださって構いません。

key: And you have my heartfelt thanks for helping escort my sister and her friends away from that awful place.
en: And you have my heartfelt thanks for helping escort my sister and her friends away from that awful place.
ja: それと、あんな酷い場所から姉と友人たちを連れ出すのを手伝ってくださって、心から感謝しています。

key: CHARLOTTE: Anna is upstairs resting, by the way.
en: CHARLOTTE: Anna is upstairs resting, by the way.
ja: シャルロット: ちなみに、アンナは二階で休んでる。

key: CHARLOTTE: We were just talking about what to do about it.
en: CHARLOTTE: We were just talking about what to do about it.
ja: シャルロット: どうしたらいいか、ちょうど話してたところ。

key: CHARLOTTE: Oh, you already have some.
en: CHARLOTTE: Oh, you already have some.
ja: シャルロット: あ、もう持ってるんだ。

key: LAURA: Oh?
en: LAURA: Oh?
ja: ローラ: あら?

key: You came prepared, then.
en: You came prepared, then.
ja: 準備万端だったんですね。

key: CHARLOTTE: Like you knew this would happen.
en: CHARLOTTE: Like you knew this would happen.
ja: シャルロット: こうなるって、わかってたみたいに。

key: Impressive.
en: Impressive.
ja: やるじゃん。

key: Let's head upstairs so you can give it to her on the double.
en: Let's head upstairs so you can give it to her on the double.
ja: さっさと二階に行って、渡してあげよう。

key: LAURA: Oh, if you're going back out, you might want to rest up?
en: LAURA: Oh, if you're going back out, you might want to rest up?
ja: ローラ: あら、また外に出るなら、少し休んでいったほうがいいかもしれませんね?

key: Follow me.
en: Follow me.
ja: こちらへどうぞ。

key: SIGMUND: We meet again.
en: SIGMUND: We meet again.
ja: シグムンド: また会いましたね。

key: SIGMUND: I have no intention of extending to you the same mercy as when last we met.
en: SIGMUND: I have no intention of extending to you the same mercy as when last we met.
ja: シグムンド: 前回と同じ慈悲を、あなたに与えるつもりはありません。

key: I am here to reclaim what you have stolen from me.
en: I am here to reclaim what you have stolen from me.
ja: あなたが私から盗んだものを、取り戻しに来たのです。

key: Those children belong at the Orphanage.
en: Those children belong at the Orphanage.
ja: あの子どもたちは、孤児院に属するものです。

key: They are my property.
en: They are my property.
ja: 私の所有物なのですよ。

key: However, I know that you are not to be underestimated.
en: However, I know that you are not to be underestimated.
ja: しかし、あなたを侮ってはいけないことも承知しています。

key: Therefore...
en: Therefore...
ja: ですから……

key: Orderlies, detain \PN.
en: Orderlies, detain \PN.
ja: 職員たち、\PNを拘束しなさい。

key: I'll search the upper floor.
en: I'll search the upper floor.
ja: 私は上階を捜索します。

key: This is your third trial. How many more will you endure?
en: This is your third trial. How many more will you endure?
ja: これでお前の三度目の試練だ。あと何度耐えられる?

key: You were occupied so the Doctor can do as he pleases. That is all that was required of us.
en: You were occupied so the Doctor can do as he pleases. That is all that was required of us.
ja: お前の相手をして、ドクターに好きにさせる。それが俺たちに求められたことのすべてだ。

key: ORDERLY: Our loss is inconsequential.
en: ORDERLY: Our loss is inconsequential.
ja: 職員: 我々の敗北など、取るに足らない。

key: The Doctor has all the time he needs.
en: The Doctor has all the time he needs.
ja: ドクターには、必要な時間がすべて与えられている。

key: SIRIUS: Blast that feral woman!
en: SIRIUS: Blast that feral woman!
ja: シリウス: あの野蛮な女め!

key: ORDERLY: Where is the rest of your team?
en: ORDERLY: Where is the rest of your team?
ja: 職員: お前の部下たちは、どこにいる?

key: SIRIUS: Gone.
en: SIRIUS: Gone.
ja: シリウス: 消えた。

key: Dead, for all I know.
en: Dead, for all I know.
ja: 死んでいるかもしれんな。

key: That accursed woman with the Dragonite came and shot us down as we were crossing the lake.
en: That accursed woman with the Dragonite came and shot us down as we were crossing the lake.
ja: あのカイリューを連れた忌々しい女が、湖を渡っている最中に我々を撃ち落としたのだ。

key: I clipped her wings in return, and hauled myself out of the water.
en: I clipped her wings in return, and hauled myself out of the water.
ja: 私はお返しに奴の翼を切り落として、自力で水からはい上がった。

key: Now I am NOT leaving here empty-handed.
en: Now I am NOT leaving here empty-handed.
ja: 手ぶらでここを去るつもりは、断じてない。

key: And YOU.
en: And YOU.
ja: それと、お前。

key: Where is your purple-clad friend?
en: Where is your purple-clad friend?
ja: 紫色の服を着た、お前の友人はどこだ?

key: Make a fool out of me, will you?
en: Make a fool out of me, will you?
ja: 私を笑い者にしてくれたな?

key: My office is in pieces thanks to you!
en: My office is in pieces thanks to you!
ja: お前のせいで、私の執務室は粉々だぞ!

key: It is only thanks to my quick wit that I even escaped that little trap of yours unscathed.
en: It is only thanks to my quick wit that I even escaped that little trap of yours unscathed.
ja: お前のあのわなから無傷で逃れられたのは、私の機転のおかげにすぎん。

key: Don't you DARE deign to stand in my way ever again!
en: Don't you DARE deign to stand in my way ever again!
ja: 二度と、私の邪魔をしようなどと思わぬことだ!

key: ENOUGH! Be glad your dragon-friend softened us up.
en: ENOUGH! Be glad your dragon-friend softened us up.
ja: もういい! 貴様の竜づれが　我らを削いでくれたことを　感謝するのだな

key: SIRIUS: So you have fight in you still.
en: SIRIUS: So you have fight in you still.
ja: シリウス: まだ、闘志は残っているようだな。

key: LAURA: Aaaaaaah!!!
en: LAURA: Aaaaaaah!!!
ja: ローラ: きゃあああああ!!!

key: SIRIUS: Oh?
en: SIRIUS: Oh?
ja: シリウス: ほう?

key: After an ocean of ill-tidings, fortune smiles on me after all.
en: After an ocean of ill-tidings, fortune smiles on me after all.
ja: 悪い知らせの海の果てに、ようやく幸運が微笑んだか。

key: It sounds like someone upstairs has been hurt.
en: It sounds like someone upstairs has been hurt.
ja: 上階で誰かが怪我をしたようだな。

key: So, will you rush upstairs to help her, and let me do as I please?
en: So, will you rush upstairs to help her, and let me do as I please?
ja: さて、彼女を助けに上階へ急ぎ、私に好きにさせるか?

key: Or will you abandon your friend to keep me fast in place?
en: Or will you abandon your friend to keep me fast in place?
ja: それとも、友を見捨てて私をここに縛りつけておくか?

key: SIGMUND: Laura.
en: SIGMUND: Laura.
ja: シグムンド: ローラ。

key: LAURA: Doctor........
en: LAURA: Doctor........
ja: ローラ: ドクター……

key: SIGMUND: It's been some time.
en: SIGMUND: It's been some time.
ja: シグムンド: 久しぶりですね。

key: I trust you're doing well despite your refusal to remain in treatment.
en: I trust you're doing well despite your refusal to remain in treatment.
ja: 治療を拒んだにもかかわらず、元気にしているようで何よりです。

key: LAURA: Doctor, I'm of legal age now.
en: LAURA: Doctor, I'm of legal age now.
ja: ローラ: ドクター、わたしはもう成人です。

key: You have no authority over me.
en: You have no authority over me.
ja: あなたに、わたしへの権限はありません。

key: This is my house, so please leave.
en: This is my house, so please leave.
ja: ここはわたしの家です、出て行ってください。

key: SIGMUND: If only I was here for you.
en: SIGMUND: If only I was here for you.
ja: シグムンド: 私があなたのためにここに来たのであればよかったのですが。

key: You know that as well as I do.
en: You know that as well as I do.
ja: それは、あなたも私と同じくらいよくご存じでしょう。

key: Yet, it is very like you to shy away from any source of conflict.
en: Yet, it is very like you to shy away from any source of conflict.
ja: それでも、対立の種から目を逸らすのは、実にあなたらしい。

key: We can avoid having to escalate the situation, if only you'll tell me where the others are.
en: We can avoid having to escalate the situation, if only you'll tell me where the others are.
ja: 他の子どもたちの居場所さえ教えてくれれば、事態を大きくせずに済みます。

key: I know all of your weaknesses, Laura.
en: I know all of your weaknesses, Laura.
ja: あなたの弱点は、すべて把握していますよ、ローラ。

key: And you have so many of them.
en: And you have so many of them.
ja: それも、実にたくさんね。

key: LAURA: Do you really think me so frail that I would hand over my own friends at a mere threat?
en: LAURA: Do you really think me so frail that I would hand over my own friends at a mere threat?
ja: ローラ: たかが脅しひとつで、自分の友人を差し出すほど、わたしが弱いと本気で思っているんですか?

key: If that is your understanding of me, Doctor, I'm afraid you have a lot more studying left to do!
en: If that is your understanding of me, Doctor, I'm afraid you have a lot more studying left to do!
ja: それがあなたのわたしへの理解なら、ドクター、まだまだ勉強不足のようですね!

key: SIGMUND: So that's how it is.
en: SIGMUND: So that's how it is.
ja: シグムンド: そういうことですか。

key: Electivire.
en: Electivire.
ja: エレキブル。

key: LAURA: Doctor, you know just as well as anyone that I am a member of the Elite Four.
en: LAURA: Doctor, you know just as well as anyone that I am a member of the Elite Four.
ja: ローラ: ドクター、わたしがエリートフォーの一員だということは、誰よりもよくご存じのはずですよね。

key: Please do not believe you can defeat me.
en: Please do not believe you can defeat me.
ja: わたしに勝てるなどと、思わないでください。

key: SIGMUND: Lizzy, Lizzy...
en: SIGMUND: Lizzy, Lizzy...
ja: シグムンド: リジー、リジー……

key: I know... Yes, I know.
en: I know... Yes, I know.
ja: わかっていますよ……ええ、わかっています。

key: LAURA: Pardon?
en: LAURA: Pardon?
ja: ローラ: 何ですか?

key: SIGMUND: I will do what must be done for your sake.
en: SIGMUND: I will do what must be done for your sake.
ja: シグムンド: あなたのために、必要なことをするまでです。

key: It pains me to do this, really.
en: It pains me to do this, really.
ja: 本当に、これは心が痛みます。

key: Electivire, Thunder Wave.
en: Electivire, Thunder Wave.
ja: エレキブル、でんじは。

key: 145 volts-- on Laura herself.
en: 145 volts-- on Laura herself.
ja: 145ボルト――ローラ自身にだ。

key: LAURA: Aaaaaa--
en: LAURA: Aaaaaa--
ja: ローラ: ああああ――

key: SIGMUND: You always did freeze up past a certain threshold.
en: SIGMUND: You always did freeze up past a certain threshold.
ja: シグムンド: あなたはいつも、ある一定の限度を超えると、動けなくなりましたね。

key: I'll thank you for stepping aside.
en: I'll thank you for stepping aside.
ja: どいてくれて助かります。

key: SIGMUND: Do not worry, child.
en: SIGMUND: Do not worry, child.
ja: シグムンド: 心配いりませんよ、お嬢さん。

key: As ever, I will remind you that the discomfort you feel is imaginary.
en: As ever, I will remind you that the discomfort you feel is imaginary.
ja: いつも言っている通り、あなたが感じている不快感は、想像上のものにすぎません。

key: Outside stimuli are only as powerful as the effect we allow them to have in our own minds.

en: Based on where she and the Steelix fell, it won't be far from Tanzan Mountain.

ja: シェリー: そこって……そこって、チームメテオの基地があった場所だよね?

key: NOEL: Perhaps you'd better hurry.
en: NOEL: Perhaps you'd better hurry.
ja: ノエル: 急いだ方がいいかもしれない。

key: NOEL: Perhaps you'd better hurry to find Saphira.
en: NOEL: Perhaps you'd better hurry to find Saphira.
ja: ノエル: サファイラを探しに、急いだ方がいいかもしれない。

key: NOEL: I tried to tell her that she shouldn't eavesdrop.
en: NOEL: I tried to tell her that she shouldn't eavesdrop.

en: ANNA: Yeah, but she was so cool riding that giant Steelix!

key: Do you think when she comes back, she'll let us all take a ride together?
en: Do you think when she comes back, she'll let us all take a ride together?
ja: 戻ってきたら、みんなで一緒に乗せてもらえるかな?

key: NOEL: Anna, she fell off of it at the peak of Tanzan Mountain.
en: NOEL: Anna, she fell off of it at the peak of Tanzan Mountain.
ja: ノエル: アンナ、彼女はタンザン山の頂上から落ちたんだ。

key: Saphira probably won't make it.
en: Saphira probably won't make it.
ja: サファイラは、たぶん助からない。

key: ANNA: Noel! Don't lie!
en: ANNA: Noel! Don't lie!
ja: アンナ: ノエル! うそつかないで!

key: NOEL: I'm not.
en: NOEL: I'm not.
ja: ノエル: うそじゃない。

key: Nomos says it's a rough fall too.
en: Nomos says it's a rough fall too.
ja: ノモスも、かなり酷い落ち方だったって言ってる。

key: Don't get your hopes up, all right?
en: Don't get your hopes up, all right?
ja: 期待しすぎない方がいい、いいね?

key: ANNA: If you don't have any hope, then how can you keep moving forward?
en: ANNA: If you don't have any hope, then how can you keep moving forward?
ja: アンナ: 希望を持たなかったら、どうやって前に進めるの?

key: CHARLOTTE: Oh, please. I'm sure she'll pull some mid-air "Dragonite, help me out!" thing and then just fly away peacefully.
en: CHARLOTTE: Oh, please. I'm sure she'll pull some mid-air "Dragonite, help me out!" thing and then just fly away peacefully.
ja: シャルロット: やめてよ。どうせ空中で「カイリュー、助けて!」とかやって、平然と飛んで逃げるに決まってる。

key: People in our family DON'T go out that easily.
en: People in our family DON'T go out that easily.
ja: うちの家族は、そんな簡単にくたばったりしないの。

key: SHELLY: Speaking of your family... where are your parents?
en: SHELLY: Speaking of your family... where are your parents?
ja: シェリー: 家族と言えば……あなたたちの両親は、どこにいるの?

key: CHARLOTTE: There's a reason we were in the Orphanage, you know.
en: CHARLOTTE: There's a reason we were in the Orphanage, you know.
ja: シャルロット: あたしたちが孤児院にいたのには、理由があるんだけど。

key: CHARLOTTE: Rather than that,
en: CHARLOTTE: Rather than that,
ja: シャルロット: それより、

key: Who was the woman with the Hydreigon?
en: Who was the woman with the Hydreigon?
ja: あのサザンドラに乗ってた女は誰?

key: ANNA: There was a lady there?
en: ANNA: There was a lady there?
ja: アンナ: 女の人がいたの?

key: I didn't see anyone...
en: I didn't see anyone...
ja: 誰も見なかったけど……

key: NOEL: Yes, Anna. That Hydreigon didn't just appear on its own.
en: NOEL: Yes, Anna. That Hydreigon didn't just appear on its own.
ja: ノエル: いたんだよ、アンナ。あのサザンドラが、勝手に現れたわけじゃない。

key: Someone was riding it.
en: Someone was riding it.
ja: 誰かが乗っていた。

key: \PN, would you have any idea?
en: \PN, would you have any idea?
ja: \PN、何か心当たりある?

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Lin?
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Lin?
ja: シャルロット: ……リン?

key: That's a gross name.
en: That's a gross name.
ja: 気持ち悪い名前。

key: ANNA: Hey! You didn't happen to get my Pendant back, did you?
en: ANNA: Hey! You didn't happen to get my Pendant back, did you?
ja: アンナ: ねえ! あたしのペンダント、取り戻せなかったよね?

key: The Amethyst Pendant?
en: The Amethyst Pendant?
ja: アメジストのペンダント。

key: What do you mean, they're using it as a key?
en: What do you mean, they're using it as a key?
ja: それを鍵として使ってるって、どういうこと?

key: SHELLY: A key? Wait...
en: SHELLY: A key? Wait...
ja: シェリー: 鍵? 待って……

key: I just remembered an old story I read...
en: I just remembered an old story I read...
ja: 前に読んだ古い話を、今思い出したんだけど……

key: In the story, it described an ancient city built around the crash site of a meteor.
en: In the story, it described an ancient city built around the crash site of a meteor.
ja: その話には、いん石の落下地点の周りに築かれた古代都市のことが書かれてたの。

key: The temple that housed the meteor was sealed by four crystal keys: Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald and Amethyst.
en: The temple that housed the meteor was sealed by four crystal keys: Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald and Amethyst.
ja: いん石を収めた神殿は、ルビー、サファイア、エメラルド、アメジストの四つの結晶の鍵で封じられてたって。

key: But the city fell into ruin, and it was lost.
en: But the city fell into ruin, and it was lost.
ja: でも、その都市は廃虚となって、失われてしまったの。

key: What if your Amethyst Pendant is actually the key from that story?
en: What if your Amethyst Pendant is actually the key from that story?
ja: もしかして、あんたのアメジストのペンダントって、その話に出てくる鍵なんじゃ?

key: NOEL: Then, that would mean that the ancient city...
en: NOEL: Then, that would mean that the ancient city...
ja: ノエル: だとしたら、その古代都市っていうのは……

key: CHARLOTTE: Became Reborn.
en: CHARLOTTE: Became Reborn.
ja: シャルロット: リボーンになった、ってこと。

key: SHELLY: So the ancient temple is just underneath Reborn City?
en: SHELLY: So the ancient temple is just underneath Reborn City?
ja: シェリー: つまり、古代の神殿はリボーンシティのすぐ下にあるってこと?

key: That must be why they blew up the Grand Stairway!
en: That must be why they blew up the Grand Stairway!
ja: だから、大階段を爆破したんだ!

key: I heard when the city officials explored underneath the Stairway, they found a huge cavern with a ruin at its base.
en: I heard when the city officials explored underneath the Stairway, they found a huge cavern with a ruin at its base.
ja: 市の職員が大階段の下を調査した時、底に遺跡のある巨大な洞窟が見つかったって聞いたことがある。

key: CHARLOTTE: They found the lock, and now they need the keys.
en: CHARLOTTE: They found the lock, and now they need the keys.
ja: シャルロット: 錠は見つけた、だから今は鍵が必要ってわけ。

key: ANNA: Heather's Ruby Ring must be one of the keys, too!
en: ANNA: Heather's Ruby Ring must be one of the keys, too!
ja: アンナ: ヘザーのルビーのゆびわも、鍵のひとつのはず!

key: We have to stop Team Meteor from getting those other keys!
en: We have to stop Team Meteor from getting those other keys!
ja: チームメテオが他の鍵を手に入れるのを、止めなきゃ!

key: Whatever they're trying to do down there, it can't be good!
en: Whatever they're trying to do down there, it can't be good!
ja: あそこで何をしようとしてるにせよ、ろくなことじゃないはず!

key: LAURA: Which leaves Emerald and Sapphire, right?
en: LAURA: Which leaves Emerald and Sapphire, right?
ja: ローラ: 残るは、エメラルドとサファイアですよね?

key: CHARLOTTE: Wait, so these keys are embedded into jewelry, right?
en: CHARLOTTE: Wait, so these keys are embedded into jewelry, right?
ja: シャルロット: 待って、じゃあ鍵って、宝石類に埋め込まれてるってこと?

key: Laura, do you remember those Sapphire Bracelets Dad gave you as a present for your birthday that one year?
en: Laura, do you remember those Sapphire Bracelets Dad gave you as a present for your birthday that one year?
ja: ローラ、お父さんがあの年、誕生日プレゼントにくれたサファイアのブレスレット、覚えてる?

key: LAURA: Oh, I had entirely forgotten........
en: LAURA: Oh, I had entirely forgotten........
ja: ローラ: あら、すっかり忘れていました……

key: CHARLOTTE: Where are they now?
en: CHARLOTTE: Where are they now?

ja: ローラ: わたし――

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Oh.
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Oh.
ja: シャルロット: ……そう。

en: LAURA: It's possible it didn't survive the fire........

en: Is that where you got those burn scars from?

en: CHARLOTTE: Anna, for the last time, I don't have any scars.
ja: シャルロット: アンナ、もう一回だけ言うけど、あたしに傷跡なんてないから。

key: See? Perfectly clear.
en: See? Perfectly clear.

key: SHELLY: I don't see anything...
en: SHELLY: I don't see anything...
ja: シェリー: 何も見えないけど……

en: ANNA: Right! Sorry, I keep forgetting!
ja: アンナ: そうだった! ごめん、いつも忘れちゃう!

en: I won't talk about them anymore!
ja: もう話さないから!

en: But since it is important, what fire are you talking about?
ja: でも、大事なことだから聞くけど、その火事って何のこと?

en: LAURA: Um, well........
ja: ローラ: ええと、その……

en: It was something that happened with Charlotte when we were younger.
ja: わたしたちがまだ幼かった頃、シャルロットに起きたことです。

key: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, okay. I don't wanna be here for this.
en: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, okay. I don't wanna be here for this.
ja: シャルロット: はいはい、この話にはいたくないから。

en: LAURA: Charlotte........!

ja: シャルロット: ねえ、姉さんならきっと大丈夫。

ja: あのサファイラの話をしてるんだから。

key: She's not gonna go out that easy.
en: She's not gonna go out that easy.
ja: そんな簡単にくたばったりしない。

key: LAURA: Until she proves otherwise, I'm going to be worried about her........
en: LAURA: Until she proves otherwise, I'm going to be worried about her........
ja: ローラ: 違うと証明されるまで、わたしは心配し続けると思います……

key: LAURA: T-thanks, Anna........
en: LAURA: T-thanks, Anna........
ja: ローラ: あ、ありがとう、アンナ……

key: You're right, I shouldn't be too hard on myself........
en: You're right, I shouldn't be too hard on myself........
ja: その通りですね、自分を追い詰めすぎちゃいけません……

key: I just can't stand the thought of losing either of them.
en: I just can't stand the thought of losing either of them.
ja: ただ、二人のどちらかを失うなんて、考えるだけで耐えられなくて。

key: Not when they're all I have.
en: Not when they're all I have.
ja: だって、二人しかいないんですから。

key: I don't know how they always keep their cool all the time.
en: I don't know how they always keep their cool all the time.
ja: あの二人が、どうしていつも冷静でいられるのか、わたしにはわかりません。

key: Saphira tells me-- that our emotions make us strong.
en: Saphira tells me-- that our emotions make us strong.
ja: サファイラは言うんです――感情があるからこそ、わたしたちは強くなれるって。

key: I understand how she finds the drive to fight as hard as she does all the time, but me........
en: I understand how she finds the drive to fight as hard as she does all the time, but me........
ja: あの人が、いつもあんなに激しく戦う原動力を見つけられる理由はわかる気がします。でも、わたしは……

key: I think I'm just compromised.
en: I think I'm just compromised.
ja: わたしは、ただ揺らいでるだけなんだと思います。

key: But then she tells me,
en: But then she tells me,
ja: でも、そう言うと、彼女は言うんです、

key: No,
en: No,
ja: ちがう、

key: I'm just a different kind of strong.
en: I'm just a different kind of strong.

key: It's such a steep drop...

en: NOEL: \PN, can I talk to you in the other room for a second?

key: A photograph is tucked away next to an issue of Dragon Tamer Monthly.
en: A photograph is tucked away next to an issue of Dragon Tamer Monthly.
ja: 「月刊ドラゴン使い」の隣に、一枚の写真がしまい込まれている。

key: Take it?
en: Take it?
ja: 手に取りますか?

key: An issue of "Dragon Tamer Monthly"...
en: An issue of "Dragon Tamer Monthly"...
ja: 「月刊ドラゴン使い」の一冊……

key: LAURA: Thank you for allowing me a moment to cleanse the vessels.
en: LAURA: Thank you for allowing me a moment to cleanse the vessels.
ja: ローラ: 器を清める時間をいただき、ありがとうございます。

key: LAURA: I hope it was to your liking.
en: LAURA: I hope it was to your liking.
ja: ローラ: お口に合っていればいいのですが。

key: This particular blend was with rose and matcha, with a garnish of cornflower and stargazer lily.
en: This particular blend was with rose and matcha, with a garnish of cornflower and stargazer lily.
ja: 今回のブレンドは、ローズと抹茶をベースに、ヤグルマギクとカサブランカを添えたものです。

key: I have been working on several other blends, but I believe they're not quite ready to sample just yet.
en: I have been working on several other blends, but I believe they're not quite ready to sample just yet.
ja: 他にもいくつかブレンドに取り組んでいるんですが、まだお試しいただける段階ではないと思います。

key: I'd like to continue tweaking the proportions to bring out as much of the flavor as possible.
en: I'd like to continue tweaking the proportions to bring out as much of the flavor as possible.
ja: できるだけ風味を引き出せるよう、配合をさらに調整していきたいと思っています。

key: ...I do find the whole affair suits me quite well though.
en: ...I do find the whole affair suits me quite well though.
ja: ……この作業全体が、わたしにはとても性に合っているように思います。

key: It was Bennett's suggestion that I perhaps pursue this as an additional hobby.
en: It was Bennett's suggestion that I perhaps pursue this as an additional hobby.
ja: これを新しい趣味として始めてみてはと勧めてくれたのは、ベネットでした。

key: After all, the act of powdering and mixing each of the different components is a rather delicate process.
en: After all, the act of powdering and mixing each of the different components is a rather delicate process.
ja: 何しろ、それぞれの材料を粉にして混ぜ合わせる作業は、かなり繊細な工程ですから。

key: To be honest, I find it quite relaxing.
en: To be honest, I find it quite relaxing.
ja: 正直なところ、とても落ち着けると感じています。

key: What's more, it provides a use for the flowers I've already been growing.
en: What's more, it provides a use for the flowers I've already been growing.
ja: それに、すでに育てている花たちの使い道にもなりますし。

key: I'm quite confident that, at least on the basis of ingredients alone, one couldn't do better.
en: I'm quite confident that, at least on the basis of ingredients alone, one couldn't do better.
ja: 少なくとも材料に関しては、これ以上のものはないと、かなり自信を持っています。

key: I have a great and increasing appreciation for the philosophy behind ceremonial tea serving as well.
en: I have a great and increasing appreciation for the philosophy behind ceremonial tea serving as well.
